title: A cost-effective microfluidic device for determination of biodiesel content in diesel blends
author: Soares, Samara
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Load sample into device
steps.instruction: Introduce 1.2 µL of the diesel/biodiesel sample into the microfluidic chip.

steps.title: Add alkaline hydroxylamine
steps.instruction: Introduce the alkaline hydroxylamine reagent to the sample to initiate derivatization.

substeps.instruction: Add 480 µg of NaOH to make the solution alkaline.

steps.title: Form colored Fe(III) complex
steps.instruction: Add Fe(III) reagent so that the generated alkyl hydroxamates react to give a colored Fe(III) complex.

substeps.instruction: Add 14 µg of Fe(III) to the reaction mixture.

steps.title: Add nitric acid equivalent
steps.instruction: Introduce an amount of nitric acid equivalent to 1.2 µL of 69 % (v/v) HNO₃.

steps.title: Capture smartphone image
steps.instruction: Place the chip under the smartphone camera, acquire a digital image, and extract the green (G) channel intensity.

steps.title: Calculate biodiesel content
steps.instruction: Convert the green‑channel intensity to biodiesel concentration using the calibration equation and report the result.

substeps.instruction: Use the linear calibration: Analytical signal = 69.6 + 2.1 × C, where C is biodiesel content (% v/v).
